title: TypeScript: structured output parsing + tool schema validation helpers
author: Dana Lo
release_notes: TS template now includes a structured output parsing utility and JSON-schema-based tool argument validation with user-facing, actionable error messages. Adds common failure-mode handling for tool calls (invalid JSON, missing required props, unknown tool name, oversized tool output).
description: Context: In the TS RAG+agent template we rely on tool calling + (optionally) structured outputs. Early internal testers frequently hit hard-to-debug failures: JSON parsing errors from partial streaming chunks, tool args not matching the tool schema, and silent mismatches (e.g., model emits `tool_name` that doesn’t exist). This PR introduces a small set of helper utilities and conventions to make these cases deterministic and supportable. What’s included: (1) `parseStructuredOutput<T>()` with strict JSON parsing, clearer error surfaces, and a consistent “user error vs system error” split; (2) JSON-schema validation for tool arguments (Ajv) and tool results where applicable, with guardrails for max payload size; (3) standardized error codes/messages that match the template error taxonomy draft; (4) span + log hooks to record validation failures without logging raw user content; (5) docs updates in the template README troubleshooting section with common failure modes and suggested remediation. Design goals: keep provider lock-in minimal (helpers sit above the SDK), keep defaults safe (redaction + size limits), and keep it easy for users to add tools without learning the whole stack. Example usage: define tools with `{ name, description, schema }` and run `validateToolArgs(tool, args)` before calling the implementation; use `parseStructuredOutput` for model responses where `response_format` is enabled.
commits: feat(ts): add structured output parser with typed return + better error messages
feat(ts): add Ajv-based tool args validation + error mapping
feat(ts): add tool registry + unknown-tool handling
chore(ts): add size limits + redaction-safe logging helpers for tool failures
docs(ts): troubleshooting section for schema/structured output errors
test(ts): add unit tests for parser + schema validation edge cases
failure_modes_documented: STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_JSON_INVALID: model returned invalid JSON (often due to truncated/partial streaming chunk); fix: disable streaming for structured mode or use provided buffering helper
STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: JSON parsed but missing required properties; fix: update prompt/instructions or schema; ensure casing matches
TOOL_UNKNOWN: model requested a tool not in registry; fix: tighten tool list in prompt + ensure tool registry passed to agent loop
TOOL_ARGS_INVALID: args fail JSON-schema validation; fix: adjust schema descriptions/examples; add `enum` constraints if needed
TOOL_RESULT_TOO_LARGE: tool output exceeds configured max bytes; fix: summarize or paginate tool results
TOOL_HANDLER_ERROR: tool threw runtime error; fix: add retries/timeouts inside tool and ensure error is mapped to user-safe message
conversation: Monica Patel (review): The helper set looks good. Two asks: (1) make sure we never log raw `toolArgs` on validation failure, and (2) align error code strings with the draft taxonomy. Dana Lo (author): Updated `errorMapping.ts` to only log `schema_errors` summaries and to redact values; also normalized codes to `TOOL_ARGS_INVALID`, `TOOL_UNKNOWN`, `STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_JSON_INVALID`, etc. Ibrahim Khan (review): Streaming + structured JSON parsing is a minefield. Can we avoid partial JSON parse attempts? Dana Lo: Added `streamingJson.ts` helper that buffers until a balanced JSON object is detected (best-effort), and in strict mode we require final chunk completion; also updated README to recommend non-streaming for strict structured mode. Allison Grant (review): Please add trace attributes but keep cardinality low. Specifically: tool_name ok; schema_errors should not be a metric label. Dana Lo: Added span events for validation failures, and only `tool.name` and `error.code` as attributes. No schema errors in metrics. Sabrina James (review): Tests should cover empty args, additionalProperties false, and unknown tool name. Dana Lo: Added unit tests for those cases + a regression test for a previously-seen `Unexpected token` parse error. Monica Patel (final): Approving after redaction changes + naming alignment. Allison Grant: Approve.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Monica Patel. Squash commit message: "TypeScript: structured output parsing + tool schema validation helpers"
